# KCONE Pilates

> KCONE Pilates is a China-based manufacturer of professional Pilates equipment for studios, distributors, fitness chains, training academies, wellness spaces, and rehabilitation-oriented facilities.

## Business Information

KCONE works directly with studios, distributors, and fitness chains worldwide. The website is inquiry-based rather than public-price ecommerce. Buyers can request KCONE product specifications, quotation, MOQ details, lead times, and FOB Shanghai or DDU export packaging information. KCONE is a proprietary brand manufacturer focused on its own branded professional Pilates equipment collection. The public product collection may be upgraded over time, so long-term content should use category-level language rather than treating current model names as permanent.

KCONE supports product review through specifications, photos, videos, FOB Shanghai or DDU export packaging details, lead time, and quotation discussions before order confirmation.

Large Pilates machines are usually evaluated through product specifications, detailed photos, demonstration videos, packaging details, lead time, quotation discussions, and order planning rather than small-sample purchasing.

Trade terms: KCONE quotes on FOB Shanghai or DDU. Under FOB, the buyer arranges the main international freight with its own forwarder after port handover; under DDU, KCONE arranges delivery to the buyer's destination while the buyer handles import duties and local clearance.

Compliance requirements vary by destination market and order scope. Buyers should confirm import, studio, medical, freight, and regulatory requirements before ordering.
